units.source_text: 藤壶妃子分娩的日期，照算该是去年十二月中。

en.t: By the reckoning, Lady Fujitsubo's confinement should have come around the middle of the previous December.

units.source_text: 但十二月毫无动静地过去了。

en.t: But December passed without the slightest sign of anything happening.

units.source_text: 大家有些担心。

en.t: Everyone began to feel somewhat worried.

units.source_text: 到了新年，三条众侍女都等得心焦了，

en.t: When the New Year came, all the ladies-in-waiting at Sanjo had grown anxious from waiting.

units.source_text: 大家想：“无论如何，这个正月里一定做产。”

en.t: They all thought, "Whatever happens, she is sure to give birth during this first month."

units.source_text: 宫中也如此预料。

en.t: The palace also expected the same.

units.source_text: 然而正月又无事地过去了。

en.t: Yet the first month too passed without incident.

units.source_text: 世人纷纷议论：如此迟产，敢是着了妖魔？

en.t: People everywhere began to gossip: with the birth so delayed, could some evil spirit be involved?

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子忧心忡忡，生怕因此泄露隐事，

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo was deeply troubled, fearing that this might expose the hidden affair.

units.source_text: 以致身败名裂，心中痛苦万状。

en.t: If it led to her ruin and disgrace, the thought filled her heart with unbearable anguish.

units.source_text: 源氏中将推算月数，愈加确信此事与自己有关，

en.t: Lieutenant General Genji counted the months and became still more certain that the matter was connected with him.

units.source_text: 便借口他事，在各寺院举行法事，以祈祷安产。

en.t: So, under the pretext of other business, he had rites performed at various temples to pray for a safe delivery.

units.source_text: 他想：世事难知，安危莫测。

en.t: He thought: worldly affairs are hard to know, and safety or danger cannot be predicted.

units.source_text: 我和她结了这露水因缘，难道就此永别？

en.t: She and I were joined by this fleeting bond like dew; can it be that we must part forever now?

units.source_text: 左思右想，不胜愁叹。

en.t: Turning it over again and again in his mind, he was overwhelmed by sorrow and lamentation.

units.source_text: 幸而过了二月初十之后，平安地产下了一个男孩。

en.t: Fortunately, after the tenth day of the second month had passed, she safely gave birth to a boy.

units.source_text: 于是忧虑全消，宫中及三条院诸人皆大欢喜。

en.t: At once all anxiety vanished, and everyone in the palace and at Sanjo was overjoyed.

units.source_text: 皇上盼望藤壶妃子长生不老，

en.t: The Emperor wished that Lady Fujitsubo might live long and never grow old.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子想起了那件隐事，但觉痛心。

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo remembered that secret affair and felt only pain in her heart.

units.source_text: 然而她闻知弘徽殿女御等正在诅咒她，

en.t: But when she learned that the Kokiden Consort and the others were cursing her,

units.source_text: 希望她难产而死，假如果真死了，倒教她们快意。

en.t: hoping she would die in a difficult childbirth, she thought that if she really died, it would only delight them.

units.source_text: 想到这里，精神振奋起来，身体也渐渐恢复健康了。

en.t: Thinking this, her spirits rose, and her body gradually recovered its health.
